description: Condense scattered chat messages, notes, or logs into a concise structured daily standup summary. Use when: (1) asked to summarize a team's daily standup from raw chat logs or messages, (2) converting unstructured notes into a standup format (What I did / What I'll do / Blockers), (3) preparing a standup report from multiple sources of team activity, (4) generating a daily progress update for agile/standup meetings.
